summary.zh: 读写云文档、消息与成员
summary.en: Read and write docs, messages, and members

description.zh: 搜索和读写飞书云文档、查看群消息与成员、读取用户信息。适合把飞书里的资料带进对话或整理会议结论。首次连接跳转飞书账号登录并授权。
description.en: Search and edit Feishu docs, read group messages and members, and fetch user profiles. Good for bringing Feishu material into a conversation or turning meeting notes into documents. Feishu sign-in and consent happen in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接跳转飞书登录并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Feishu and authorize on first connect
